text: 天眼查App显示，近日，杭州群核信息技术有限公司发生工商变更，注册资本由约14.91亿人民币增至约16.91亿人民币。杭州群核信息技术有限公司成立于2011年11月，法定代表人为黄晓煌，经营范围包括信息技术咨询服务、货物进出口、技术进出口、技术服务、技术开发、技术咨询、技术交流、技术转让、技术推广等。
text_en: Tianyancha App shows that Hangzhou Qunhe Information Technology Co., Ltd. recently underwent a business registration change, with registered capital increasing from approximately 1.491 billion yuan to approximately 1.691 billion yuan. Hangzhou Qunhe Information Technology Co., Ltd. was established in November 2011, with legal representative Huang Xiaohuang, and its business scope includes IT consulting services, goods import/export, technology import/export, technical services, development, consulting, exchange, transfer, and promotion.
